free_text_notes.physician_note: 54-year-old man with CAD s/p PCI, CKD stage 3, admitted 3/5 with HFpEF exacerbation precipitated by dietary sodium excess. Net negative 6.8 L this admission; dyspnea back to baseline.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Up in chair for meals. Pain controlled. A routine ECG was performed on day 3. The result showed no changes compared to the admission ECG. No clinical action is needed.
free_text_notes.case_manager_note: Plan is discharge home with nephew. 3/8 18:00: Metoprolol succinate changed from 25 mg daily to 50 mg daily on evening rounds. Patient and nephew not yet told; this afternoon's teaching covered the old dose. Electrophysiology has not seen the patient yet.
